subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention contract, or keep this as memory/plugin/channel-specific improvements?
rationale: The requested behavior changes memory authority, durable storage/API/config shape, workspace-rule precedence, conflict handling, and channel reply semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep #41366 open as the canonical broad product-direction tracker while narrower Feishu bugs continue separately.

options.title: Split Into Separate Designs
options.body: Close or narrow this item after filing one memory-governance design and one channel mention-semantics design with owners and acceptance criteria.

options.title: Route Through Plugin Memory First
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning path to start as a memory/plugin API experiment before core commits to a first-class rule layer.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #41366 open as the canonical broad product-direction tracker while narrower Feishu bugs continue separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily product direction across memory and channel semantics, and steipete has adjacent product/refactor routing history in this cluster.
